page_checks.observed: Separate title page: complete title, one human author, authorized university/email, readable abstract; no clipping.
Introduction/theorem: single-column text, correct sole-author running header, precise scope and prior-work citations; no overlap.
Definitions/labels: vertex-update convention, equations and local-credibility statement legible; no missing symbols.
Progress proof/machine: finite-distance definition, memory count and reset formulas fit within text width.
Realization/deviation proof: equations and losing-bit argument legible; no clipping or overflowing lines.
Corollary/limits/AI: required-subset implication and substantial AI-use statement visible; no invented human review.
Bibliography: all five references readable, direct URLs wrap inside margins, alphanumeric labels and accents render correctly.
